sentences.text: 3. Prosecution case, in brief, is that in between on 15.06.2023, in between 7:00 and 12:30 hours, the applicant, knowing the fact that prosecutrix is complainant's minor daughter who is a member of SC/ST community, kidnapped/abducted her and kept her in captivity and committed rape on her.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that it is apparent from the statements of the prosecutrix recorded during investigation that she accompanied the applicant voluntarily and visited Bhopal, Silwani and other places through public conveyance.
She herself went with the applicant on her own will.
She was major at the time of incident as nothing material has been produced on record with regard to her age.
She was a consenting party.
No offence is made out against the applicant.
The investigation has been completed and charge-sheet has been filed.
Applicant is in custody since 26.06.2023 and the trial will take time to conclude, therefore, in the aforesaid circumstances, applicant is entitled for grant of bail.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the application and submits that prosecutrix was minor at the time of incident.
As per prosecutrix's mark-sheet of first standard, her date of birth is 06.01.2008; according to which, she was minor at the time of incident.

The offence alleged against applicant is serious in nature, therefore, he is not entitled for bail.
6.
Heard the learned counsel for both the parties.

7. Having considered rival submissions, material pointed out by the learned counsel for the applicant, statement of prosecutrix recorded during investigation so also the evidence produced on record with regard to age of prosecutrix and the fact that investigation has been completed and charge-sheet has been filed and overall facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail, hence the application is allowed.

8. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during the pendency of trial.

It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437 (3) of Cr.P.C.
9.
M.Cr.C. stands disposed of, accordingly.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
